title: [Criteria/matrix mismatch] The pass test matrix treats every post-execution failure as logs-only `not_determin
text: [Criteria/matrix mismatch] The pass test matrix treats every post-execution failure as logs-only `not_determined`, but AC1 and plan line 79 require a distinct post-publication/check-run-write failure case that records ordinary produced outcomes and preserves any success check-run surface that landed. Add that explicit scenario and assertions; otherwise a required AC1 branch is unvalidated and the plan is internally inconsistent.
